title: Frog Lake Massacre
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Frog Lake Massacre", at revision 1372135846, opens: "The Frog Lake Massacre was part of the Cree uprising during the North-West Rebellion in western Canada. Led by Wandering Spirit, Cree men attacked and killed nine officials, clergy and settlers in the small settlement of Frog Lake, at the time in the District of Saskatchewan in the North-West Territories on April 2, 1885." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5406414, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "uprising during the North-West Rebellion in western Canada". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
